definitions.explanation: Fish with white or pale-colored flesh, as opposed to red-fleshed fish. Includes species like sea bream ({鯛|たい}), flounder (ヒラメ), and cod (タラ). The category is based on the color of the raw flesh.

notes:
A culinary and everyday term for fish whose flesh is white or pale when raw. This is a fundamental category in Japanese food culture, used at sushi bars, in recipes, and in nutritional advice.

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧: sea bream
- {鱈|たら}: cod
- {鰈|かれい}: flounder
- {鱸|すずき}: sea bass

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白身魚|しろみざかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フライ→フライ：11124_furai⟧: fried white fish
- {白身魚|しろみざかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: white fish sashimi
- {白身魚|しろみざかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧: simmered white fish

RELATED WORDS:
- {赤身魚|あかみざかな}: red-fleshed fish (tuna, bonito, etc.)
- ⟦{青魚|あおざかな}→青魚：25871_aozakana⟧: blue-backed fish (mackerel, sardines, etc.)
- ⟦{白身|しろみ}→白身：13692_shiromi⟧: white flesh; also means egg white
